n_startup_trials.description: Pruning is disabled until the given number of trials finish in the same study. Default is 5.
n_startup_trials.title: N Startup Trials

n_warmup_epochs.description: Pruning is disabled until the trial exceeds the given number of epoch.
n_warmup_epochs.title: N Warmup Epochs

interval_epochs.description: Interval in number of epochs between the pruning checks, offset by the warmup epochs. If no value has been reported at the time of a pruning check, that particular check will be postponed until a value is reported.
interval_epochs.title: Interval Epochs

n_min_trials.description: Minimum number of reported trial results at an epoch to judge whether to prune. If the number of reported intermediate values from all trials at the current epoch is less than n_min_trials, the trial will not be pruned.
n_min_trials.title: N Min Trials

OptunaCfg.description:
Optuna configuration for hyperparameter optimization.

Examples
--------
>>> optuna = Optuna.model_validate({
...     "study_name": "my_study",
...     "storage": "sqlite:///optuna.db",
...     "sampler": {"type": "TPE"},
...     "direction": "minimize"}
... )

storage.description: Optuna storage URL. If None, use a in-memory non-persistent storage. Default is "sqlite:///optuna.db".
storage.title: Storage

pruner.description: Pruner to use for Optuna. Default is None (no pruning).

direction.description: Direction of optimization for Optuna. Default is 'minimize'.
direction.title: Direction

OptunaCfg.title: OptunaCfg

seed.description: Random seed for the random sampler. Default is None (no seed).
seed.title: Seed

min_epoch.description: Min epoch for the successive halving pruner. Default is "auto", which sets min_epoch to the minimum epoch in the study's trials or 1 if there are no completed trials.
min_epoch.title: Min Epoch

reduction_factor.description: Reduction factor for the successive halving pruner. Default is 4.
reduction_factor.title: Reduction Factor

min_early_stopping_rate.description: Minimum early stopping rate for the successive halving pruner. Default is 0.
min_early_stopping_rate.title: Min Early Stopping Rate

bootstrap_count.description: Number of bootstrap trials for the successive halving pruner. Default is 0.
bootstrap_count.title: Bootstrap Count

n_startup_trials.description: Number of startup trials for the TPE sampler. Default is 4.
n_startup_trials.title: N Startup Trials

experiment.description: Name of the experiment. This is used for logging and can be used to group related experiments together.
experiment.title: Experiment

topic.description: Topic or category of the experiment. This can be used for further organizing experiments.
topic.title: Topic

version.description: Version of the experiment. This can be used for tracking different iterations of the same experiment.
version.title: Version

tags.description: List of tags to associate with this experiment. This can be used for filtering and organizing experiments.
tags.title: Tags

n_trials.description: Number of trials to run. Default is 20.
n_trials.title: N Trials

test_debug.description: Whether this is a test/debug run. If True, the experiment will use a temporary Optuna storage and will log to Wandb Test & Debug project, to avoid polluting the experiment results with test runs.
test_debug.title: Test Debug

parameters_grid.description:
Grid of parameters values to explore. This experiment will be run for each combination of parameters.
The value of the parameters defined here can be referred to in the configuration file as '$<parameter_name>'
parameters_grid.title: Parameters Grid

progress_bar.description: Whether to show a progress bar during training. This can be set to False to reduce console output when running many trials.
progress_bar.title: Progress Bar

verbose.description: Whether to show verbose output during training.
verbose.title: Verbose
